rationale: John's deep conviction that agentic AI is the next frontier—moving from chat to autonomous action—aligns directly with Georgi's mission to make agentic workflow automation the default for startup GTM teams at Rilo. John's operational background across cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and ML infrastructure, combined with his community leadership at Code and Coffee, positions him as both a potential mentor on AI/ML strategy and a valuable connector to builder communities that Georgi actively targets for distribution.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Georgi—he's building Rilo, an AI-agent platform automating GTM workflows for startups, and is actively hiring for GTM roles; your expertise in agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, and developer communities could be valuable as a sounding board and connector.
